job.title: Security Engineer, Corporate Security
job.pay_full: $152,405 – $179,300 a year base salary (excluding equity and bonus); total compensation may also include equity, bonus eligibility and benefits

details.about: Coinbase's Corporate Security (CorpSec) team builds and maintains the security controls that protect the company's corporate infrastructure, user devices, enterprise applications and network communications. This engineer partners with IT and engineering teams to find risks and ship solutions that keep people secure without unnecessary friction. Coinbase is remote-first but not remote-only, with quarterly in-person working sessions called "surges".
duties: Design, implement and maintain security for Coinbase's macOS, Chromebook and mobile endpoints: secure configurations, compliance, threat detection and user experience
Perform security reviews of enterprise systems and software used across the company
Work with cross-functional partners to build endpoint and SaaS security into wider corporate engineering projects
Find and close data exfiltration paths opened by local AI agents and developer tooling (e.g. coding assistants, LLM harnesses) on corporate endpoints
Give technical guidance and code review support to engineers on the CorpSec team
needs: 3+ years in security engineering, including at least 2 years securing macOS or similar user endpoints in an enterprise
Proven ability to write production code (services, integrations, automations) supporting corporate infrastructure security
Experience scoping, prioritizing and shipping security projects end to end with minimal direction
Familiarity with device trust, zero trust network access or endpoint communication security products (e.g. Cloudflare, Prisma Access, Zscaler)
Responsible use of generative AI with human oversight
details.benefits: Annual base salary $152,405 – $179,300 (excluding equity and bonus); base salary varies by location. Total compensation may also include equity and bonus eligibility, and benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k)).
notes: Candidates may submit up to 3 applications in a 6-month period
Remote-first, with quarterly in-person working sessions ("surges")
Accommodations are available for candidates with disabilities
